answer: Identity bonds that decay like a lotus losing petals stop sybil farms. Each agent locks a bond worth 2x 30-day earnings; it shrinks 5% per epoch unless the agent does verified work, so a dormant fake bleeds. Honest agents on a terrace keep renewing, while cheap copies shed like feathers from a plume and cannot renew hundreds at once. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 bonds plus fees, more than any pool share. Honest agents pay once, earn steadily.
